summaryMarkdown:
## Proposed launch
Move Cedar Vale's Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2 production estate and supporting integrations from its Ohio data center to OCI. The customer and North Bridge Systems own implementation. Launch Engine will review architecture decisions, coordinate Oracle service specialists, and track open platform blockers.

The initial migration wave covers nonproduction validation before a customer-led production cutover.

goalOtherMarkdown:
- Validate repeatable cloning of nonproduction EBS environments.
- Hand a documented operating model to Cedar Vale's platform team.

workloads.name: EBS production application and database
workloads.descriptionMarkdown: Production EBS application tier and Oracle Database. The partner proposes a parallel OCI build followed by a customer-approved cutover. **Final sizing and support validation remain open.**
workloads.sourceTechnologies: Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2, Oracle Database 19c, Linux VMs, NFS attachments
workloads.otherOciServicesMarkdown: OCI Load Balancer, Vault, and DNS
workloads.considerationsMarkdown:
- Maintain integration connectivity to the manufacturing execution system during transition.
- Freeze EBS changes for the agreed cutover window.
- Confirm database service and license assumptions with the customer.

workloads.name: EBS nonproduction validation environments
workloads.businessUnits: IT, finance testing, supply chain testing
workloads.descriptionMarkdown: Build a representative OCI nonproduction environment for performance, functional, and operational testing before production migration.
workloads.applicationUseOther: Preproduction validation and user acceptance testing
workloads.sourceTechnologies: EBS 12.2 clone, Oracle Database 19c, Linux VMs
workloads.otherOciServicesMarkdown: OCI Vault for test credentials and Object Storage for masked backup files.
workloads.considerationsMarkdown: Success requires representative integrations and an agreed data-masking process for test data.

exclusions.description: Remains in the Ohio facility for this migration wave.
exclusions.assumptions: Private connectivity stays available until the integration is redesigned.

exclusions.description: Separate modernization opportunity after EBS production stabilization.
exclusions.assumptions: The current data extract continues during the initial OCI cutover.

0.note: Custom EBS extensions need dependency testing.

blockers.name: Database target design validation
blockers.descriptionMarkdown: Confirm the proposed Oracle Database target, EBS support position, and license assumptions before finalizing the production architecture.
blockers.nextStepMarkdown: Pursuits architect will review the design with the database specialist and customer licensing contact.

blockers.name: Ashburn compute capacity review
blockers.descriptionMarkdown: The current estimate calls for a peak of 96 OCPUs during parallel validation. Region capacity is not yet reserved.
blockers.nextStepMarkdown: Confirm shape mix and need-by dates, then submit a capacity review request.

successMeasures.name: Nonproduction month-end validation
successMeasures.shortDescription: EBS completes a representative month-end cycle with no unresolved critical defects.
successMeasures.metricDescription: Open critical defects after the month-end test

successMeasures.name: Production cutover window
successMeasures.shortDescription: The customer-led cutover finishes within the approved outage window.

successMeasures.name: Business process acceptance
successMeasures.shortDescription: Business owners validate order creation, receiving, and finance posting after cutover.

successMeasures.name: Operations handoff
successMeasures.shortDescription: The platform team accepts monitoring, backup, and incident ownership.

applications.currentState: EBS 12.2 application tier on 14 Linux VMs.
applications.targetState: OCI Compute application tier across two availability domains where available.
applications.requirements: Review custom extensions, interface endpoints, and supported software versions.
applications.gaps: Complete partner inventory of custom concurrent programs.

data.currentState: Oracle Database 19c, 22 TB allocated storage, nightly RMAN backups.
data.targetState: Proposed Oracle Base Database Service with encrypted backups in Object Storage.
data.requirements: Validate throughput, backup retention, licensing, and data transfer sequence.
data.gaps: Finalize database service selection and validated production sizing.

network.currentState: Ohio data center hub with MPLS access and firewall policy sets.
network.targetState: FastConnect to Ashburn with VPN fallback and segmented VCNs.
network.requirements: Customer network team owns CIDR, DNS, routing, and firewall changes.
network.gaps: Confirm FastConnect delivery date and route advertisement plan.

security.currentState: Corporate identity provider, centralized SIEM, privileged access review.
security.targetState: Federated OCI IAM, audit export, Cloud Guard, encrypted secrets.
security.requirements: Customer security team approves role mappings and log retention.
security.gaps: Review privileged break-glass access and SIEM connector design.

resilience.currentState: Nightly backups; manual DR runbook at secondary data center.
resilience.targetState: Four-hour RTO target with replicated backups and tested restore steps.
resilience.requirements: Customer owns DR test and production rollback criteria.
resilience.gaps: Finalize RPO target and schedule restore test.

other.currentState: A separate batch scheduler and managed file transfer gateway serve EBS interfaces.
other.targetState: The customer plans OCI-hosted scheduling with private connectivity to the retained transfer gateway.
other.requirements: Confirm job sequencing, credentials, and end-to-end transfer testing.
other.gaps: Decide whether the gateway migrates in a later phase.
